name: newspaper
description: A folded newspaper with a picture, text columns and a curled lower corner.
useCase: Open news articles, press coverage or a newspaper edition.
misuse: Use file-text for a general document rather than a news publication.

16.reason: A full folded sheet, solid picture and two clear text marks keep the newspaper legible at text size.

24.reason: Separate text columns and a complete curled corner distinguish the newspaper from a generic page.
